text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's holiday was drawing to a 
close. I contacted Tosen Jordan's homeroom 
teacher and learned she had returned to 
the dorms after visiting home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I still haven't been able to get in touch 
with her, but... She might just show up 
naturally once her break is over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even if she isn't coming to training, I 
haven't heard her say she wants to 
'continue' or 'quit' yet.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's draw fortunes! I'm gonna keep 
pulling until I get Great Blessing!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, isn't that unfair? What're you gonna 
do, Jordan? Pull for it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no. I just...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Happy New Year? How've you been?
choice_data_list: Have you been doing well yourself?
How about you—have you been well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Ah... sorry for ghosting on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um... well, you know, being busy and all? 
But, um...
choice_data_list: Let's both do our best again this year

Let's both do our best again this year, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Yeah. If... I could do that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-Besides! What did you come here to pray 
for? Could it be, like, finding a new 
romance?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, isn't that nice? Should we wish for 
a heart-throbbing encounter too~?
choice_data_list:
I pray you stay healthy and keep running 
from here on out.

Wishing you good health and many more 
races to come
I'll make you even stronger by next time!
I'll make you even stronger by next time!
I hope you find a new weapon.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, isn't that nice? Should we wish for 
a heart-throbbing encounter too~?
choice_data_list:
I pray you stay healthy and keep running 
from here on out.

Wishing you good health and many more 
races to come
I'll make you even stronger by next time!
I'll make you even stronger by next time!
I hope you find a new weapon.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Forget about it. Just pray for yourself 
already.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm healthy, you know? I mean, for 
real... you've had me running plenty, 
haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Like I said...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're actually the talented type, aren't 
you? Then go ahead and become someone even 
more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I can really get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, with all that motivation you've 
got, isn't it a total waste for me to be 
the only one soaking it up?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why not check out some other girls 
too? Maybe something'll click!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're actually the talented type, aren't 
you? Then go ahead and become someone even 
more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Besides that whole "drive to win" thing? 
Ahaha, sure wish I had that~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...If only it were real... ............"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, seriously! You idealize me way 
too much~! Geez☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're actually the talented type, aren't 
you? Then go ahead and become someone even 
more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then I can just brag about how you were my 
student.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting for you anytime!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Why would you say something like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Happy New Year, City—... wait. Have 
you seen Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't been at the training grounds 
lately! If she's injured, I'd literally 
cry, and I really wanna go visit her!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
? I don't think she's hurt. She was in 
class, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see... I wonder if something's bothering 
them. I'll send a message later—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait. You haven't heard anything 
from Palmer-san or Helios-san at all?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ? Yeah, that's right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Um, maybe we shouldn't send that 
message?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan's the kind of girl who contacts us 
even when she's sick with a cold, right? 
Like, 'I'm fine, don't worry about me~'.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"And yet you haven't contacted anyone? 
Doesn't that mean..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ! You don't want to talk about it, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Jordaaan, 'sup~☆
